ai_summary: Artemis Electricals & Projects Limited reported a Q1 FY27 revenue decline of 17.62% (Rs. 1627.48 Lakhs) as it strategically shifted to higher-margin projects, which resulted in an impressive over 900% increase in EBITDA (Rs. 218.47 Lakhs) and improved PAT margins (7.81%), alongside a near elimination of long-term debt. However, a significant rise in trade receivables and payables poses a potential red flag for working capital management and collection efficiency, despite the overall profitability improvement.
